description: Labelled retrieval set for 'Attention Is All You Need'. Each item has the page(s) that answer it and a short evidence phrase copied verbatim from that page. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant only if it contains the evidence phrase (whitespace-normalized, case-insensitive). retrieval_eval.py refuses to run if any evidence phrase is missing from its page, so labels cannot silently drift. Evidence phrases are kept at or under 45 characters so every one fits inside at least one chunk even with the smallest overlap tested (50).
